title: Professional experience
answer: From June to September 2026 Hamza did a three-month development internship at Delta Quest in Sapporo, Japan, in an international team working in English: he implemented Unity (C#) features through reviewed pull requests, designed generative AI workflows with an evaluation pipeline, and worked in Agile sprints with Jira and Git/GitHub. Since May 2026 he is a developer and technical consultant at ETIC INSA Technologies, the Junior Enterprise of INSA Lyon. He also gave weekly tutoring in mathematics, physics and computer science from 2023 to 2026.
